# Pitex 1.1.6

The Pitex Agent chat for Claude Code, Antigravity and Codex now shows
what the agent does, asks before it acts, and keeps your past sessions.
The Antigravity CLI is back as an agent backend.

## New

- Antigravity CLI runs again as an agent backend over ACP.
- Tool calls appear as cards with their status, and file edits show a
  diff.
- Assistant messages render Markdown, code blocks and math.
- The agent can ask questions and propose a plan in cards you answer or
  approve. A picker sets the permission mode.
- A task checklist tracks the agent's todos.
- Import Claude Code sessions and search your chat history.
- Queue messages while a turn runs, mention files with @, and attach
  images.
- A context meter shows how full the context is. Thinking appears in
  its own block, the view stays pinned to new output, and Retry reruns
  a failed turn.
- Subagents show as their own cards, finished turns fold, and you can
  fork a chat or rewind it to an earlier message.

## Fixes

- On macOS, dragging the console divider or clicking the context meter
  while a turn streamed no longer crashes Pitex.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.1.5 update to 1.1.6 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.1.6
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
